description: E-422 (D-153, D-155; plans/rein-ecosystem-contract.md §2.6): the eight headless entry points rein-app calls, with every subcommand and flag `rein help` documents for them on 2026-11-10. Flags may be added, never removed, inside a major version (the minor, before 1.0.0). A guard row (cli_test.sh, E-422.02) fails when one of these no longer appears in `rein help` on a line for its command.
